Pairs of large green plates sold A$76-115, singles A$60-67, a butter dish lid alone A$34, so the five pieces could total about A$130-200 at separate listing prices, but the pattern and condition matter (chips, flea bites, scratches) and no UV light photo shows if it is really uranium glass (catalogue says so). Prices are 0-2 years old and steady. 8 sales found but only 1-2 close matches. Postage for large glass plates is bulky and fragile.
